turns.agent_input: A product sells for $50 with a $30 unit cost. Promotion P1 discounts price by 10% and is known to increase unit volume from 1,000 to 1,250 with no other effects. Promotion P2 keeps price at $50 and gives a $5 gift whose cost is $3; it is known to increase volume to 1,150 with no other effects. Which promotion produces more gross contribution, using the stipulated outcomes?

observations: P2 price50 plus gift cost3 volume1150
